enriched_activities.desc: Remain lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms above head. Yawn. Turn head left and right. Push blanket aside. Sit up. Swing legs over side of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Take a step.
Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up soap. Rub soap on face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap and light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and juice. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and pan from cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pour juice into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink juice. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Place phone in bag. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Look in mirror. Adjust shirt. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update patient records. Enter next patient room. Assist with procedure. Clean equipment. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Write reports. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add meat and vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Open laptop. Browse internet. Check email. Close laptop. Check phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Go to kitchen. Take snack. Return. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Go to bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out. Dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off light.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to other side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
